description: Use this when someone asks which trainers can be booked, or needs a trainer's id to book a member with them or to find their sessions. Returns up to 100 trainer ids and display names from the user's organization; a gym run by one person lists that person. Not for trainers' working hours.
name: list_trainers

trainers.description: Ids and display names of the team members with the trainer role, or of the gym's only team member when nobody has it. Roles are organization-wide, not per gym. Contact details, avatars, role records, schedules and organization data are excluded.

id.description: The id book_appointment takes in providerIds

title: List trainers who take sessions
